speaker: davy_gannet
text: Old Swan. Out on the stair you left from. The other bank stays the other bank.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not step onto it. The ring was from the water, and the water is where I left it.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Seen. Green oak, and too big, and not mine. I can be restless about a thing I have now looked at.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: The letters stand, and the posts stand, and we are on this side of the river again. That is a full afternoon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Full enough. Seventeen was said before we got in. I am not saying it again on a stair.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Then go up. I have shouted the news. Believe of it what you like.
